info.name: UICP - Unified Identity Control Plane
info.description:
Complete API collection for UICP - API-key-centric multi-tenant identity and communication platform. 

**Auth Architecture:** Tenant context derived from credentials (API Key, JWT, Session) — no X-Tenant-ID header required for authenticated endpoints.

**Key Formats (ULID-based):**
- Live Publishable: `uF{ULID26}xl` — Production client-side
- Live Secret: `sF{ULID26}xl{HMAC44}` — Production server-side  
- Dev Publishable: `pB{ULID26}` — Development
- Dev Secret: `tB{ULID26}{HMAC44}` — Development

**Auth Priority:** API Key tenantId > JWT tid claim > Session tenantId

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `baseUrl` | API base URL (e.g., http://localhost:3000) |
| `tenantId` | Tenant UUID for x-tenant-id header |
| `accessToken` | JWT access token from login |
| `refreshToken` | JWT refresh token |
| `apiKeyPublic` | Publishable API key (uF/pB prefix) |
| `apiKeySecret` | Secret API key (sF/tB prefix) |
| `platformApiKey` | Platform API key for admin endpoints |
